ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, ruffled edges, bright to mid green with darker shaded areas, slightly glossy with a light dressing sheen, covering roughly 35% of the plate in a loose mound across the lower left and center, about 12 cm across and 2-3 cm tall, sitting directly on the white plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Brown-to-tan cooked meat pieces, seared and browned edges, folded or layered slices with fibrous striated texture, some glossy juices and a light orange-pink glaze, roughly 6 x 5 cm footprint and about 2 cm thick, sitting on the upper right of the greens | 90
ITEM 3 | Small dark reddish-purple beans or berries, glossy skins, about 1-1.5 cm each, four to five pieces scattered at the left edge of the greens, firm and whole | 10
ITEM 4 | Thin light-brown or pale onion-like slivers and a small pale cream piece, soft and translucent, about 1 cm, scattered near the meat and greens | 5
ITEM 5 | Single long dark green leaf standing upright, glossy, about 6 cm long and 1 cm wide, placed at the top edge of the meat | 3
